resources.string: ScriptWidget is distributed outside Google Play (on GitHub), so it can use permissions that Play policy restricts. Allow only what you need.

Apps such as Tasker or MacroDroid can run scripts in the background with the broadcast kr.b1ink.scriptwidget.action.RUN_SCRIPT (extras: scriptName, parameter). Results come back as kr.b1ink.scriptwidget.action.SCRIPT_RESULT (output, error). While this is on, other apps can run your scripts, so turn it on only when you need it.
Scripts can send notifications with Notification.
Gets the current location with Location.current().
Uses the current location during widget refreshes too. If not allowed, the last location obtained in the app is used. Choose \"Allow all the time\" on the settings screen.
Keeps widget refreshes from being deferred while the phone is saving power.
Refreshes exactly at the time set with refreshAfterDate.
Reads and adds events with Calendar and CalendarEvent. (Reminder is stored in the app and needs no permission.)
Reads and edits contacts with Contact.
Reads recent photos and screenshots with Photos.latestPhoto(). (Picking and saving photos needs no permission.)
